title: ConceptSnapshot
description: A concept snapshot depicts what a concept looked like at a certain point in time. Each time a functional change is made, a new concept snapshot will be created. In this way, the complete editorial history of a concept is recorded.

competentLevelsOfGovernment.description: Competent level of government of a public service. This code list is managed by the IPDC - LPDC team. The valid values can be found in the ttl file on the link in the code list column. Lijst van CompetentLevelOfGovernment items.

targetGroups.description: Target group to which a public service is focused. This code list is managed by the IPDC - LPDC team. The valid values can be found in the ttl file on the link in the code list column. Lijst van TargetGroup items.

publishingChannels.description: Publication channel of a public service describes on which places the service will be visible. This code list is managed by the IPDC - LPDC team. The valid values can be found in the ttl file on the link in the code list column. When a draft has the YourEurope publication channel, at least one value must be entered in the yourEuropeCategory field. Lijst van PublicationChannel items.

tags.description: Concept tag for a public service concept. This code list is managed by the IPDC - LPDC team. The valid values can be found in the ttl file on the link in the code list column. Lijst van ConceptTag items.

themes.description: Theme of a public service. This code list is managed by the IPDC - LPDC team. The valid values can be found in the ttl file on the link in the code list column. Lijst van Theme items.

executiveLevelsOfGovernance.description: Executive level of a public service. This code list is managed by the IPDC - LPDC team. The valid values can be found in the ttl file on the link in the code list column. Lijst van ExecutiveLevel items.

yourEuropeCategories.description: YourEurope category under the Single Digital Gateway Regulation. Only services that fall within one of these categories should be forwarded to SDG. The categories and subcategories were determined by the European Parliament. These were translated by the IPDC - LPDC team into a code list in the absence of a European code list. The valid values can be found in the ttl file on the link in the code list column. Lijst van YourEuropeCategory items.

searchTerms.description: This property represents a keyword, term or phrase to describe the Public Service. There may be multiple terms per language. This is in contrast to all other fields of the type TaalString. Lijst van LanguageString items.

executiveGovernments.description: Links to the implementing organisations Lijst van PublicOrganization items.

regulations.description: The Has Legal Resource property links a Public Service to a Legal Resource. It indicates the Legal Resource (e.g. legislation) to which the Public Service relates, operates or has its legal basis. Lijst van Regulations items.

conditions.description: Textual description of the conditions for using the service. Lijst van Condition items.

websites.description: moreInfo refers to online locations where additional information about something specifically related to public service is listed Lijst van Website items.
